en.title: Rome I: where is a service supplied at a distance, for Article 6(4)(a)?
en.summary: Article 6(4)(a) takes out of the consumer rules services to be supplied to the consumer exclusively in a country other than that of his habitual residence. For a service supplied at a distance, for example online advice used by the consumer at home, the text does not say where the service is supplied.
en.impact: The same online service can fall inside or outside the consumer protection of Article 6.
en.correction: The Commission's work on the application of the Regulation could say where such a service is supplied.

quotes.source: Regulation (EC) No 593/2008 (Rome I), Official Journal, English version
quotes.text: to be supplied to the consumer exclusively in a country other than that in which he has his habitual residence
